content.title: What's the Biblical Meaning of a Pink Moon?
content.text: Shutterstock.com The pink moon is often alluded to in the Bible and secular beliefs as a symbol of change and renewal. In many cultures, the pink moon is a sign or symbol of the arrival of spring. It is the season when pink flowers begin to bloom. The full moon in April is called the “pink moon.” It got its name after flowers bloom in spring and refer to new growth. When the pink moon is out, it is a great time to release negativity or toxic relationships that have no space for your new life. Since ancient times, the moon has served humanity by tracking months and seasons. It is the Earth’s natural satellite that gives light at night and helps control the behavior and movements of the water and seas. To keep track of the months and seasons, people give the moon specific names that relate to a particular month. Because of the lunar cycle, the moon appears in different colors and conditions, such as the pink moon, the blue moon, or the orange moon. The pink moon refers to the full moon in April and is believed to allude to a type of pink flower that blooms at the start of spring. According to the Old Farmer’s Almanac, the wildflower Phlox subulata blooms at this time of year, spreading many pink flowers on the ground. The full moon in April has been named “Pink Moon” because it falls during the season when the moss-pink wildflower flourishes in North America. The Old Farmer’s Almanac also says that, in the northern hemisphere, the full moon in April is known as the “pink moon,” “full pink moon,” or “pink supermoon.” The pink moon is also sometimes called the egg moon, fish moon, grass moon, or Paschal moon. It is also referred to as the April Pink Moon, Sprouting Grass Moon, or April Full Moon. The pink moon will peak in some parts of the world one month after the full worm moon. The pink moon can also be a symbol of Jesus. God sent Jesus to Earth to “take away the sins of the world.” He suffered and died for us so that we could achieve redemption and gain eternal life. The pink moon represents Passover, the most significant event in the history of the Israelites. The beginning of spring happens around the Jewish Passover or Easter. This is the time that marks the liberation of God’s chosen people from their slavery in Egypt. It falls in April, and the pink moon’s spiritual meaning holds different significance to people and cultures on Earth. Among Native Americans, the pink moon represents renewal and rebirth. Among the Jews, the spiritual meaning of a blood moon or pink moon may signify forthcoming events of a prophetic nature or proportion. The pink moon falls close to mid-year and signifies the arrival of spring and the changing of the seasons. It marks the beginning of brighter times ahead following the dark and cold months of winter. The pink moon reminds us that life goes through seasons or cycles; bright flowers may perish, but they always blossom again the following year.
